notes: Seven rows (new_in_expanded_panel=false) are reused verbatim from output/harden_model_manifest.json: real captured ollama registry config digests, real captured parameter sizes and quantization levels, and the same honest 'not recorded' markers for Ollama version / chat-template id / num_ctx that manifest already used.

Nine rows (new_in_expanded_panel=true) are the panel-expansion models. Parameter size and quantization are reported ONLY when a numeric/quantization token is literally present in the served tag; otherwise 'not recorded' rather than imported from any outside model card, because this study's own fictional-generation served tags (qwen3.5, qwen3.6, gemma4, phi4) are not assumed equivalent to any same-named real-world release. No per-model /api/show provenance JSON was ever pulled back locally for any of the nine, so ollama_digest_sha256, inference_library_version, chat_template_id, and num_ctx are 'not recorded' for all nine, exactly the treatment the seven-model manifest already gives num_ctx/version/template.

think_mode / num_predict are hardcoded inside idrift/models/o2_runner_v2.py's ollama() function, not a per-invocation CLI flag, so they follow automatically whenever that script produced a model's data. Two of the nine (command-r:latest, llama3.1:8b) are directly named in the surviving scratchpad/o2_v3_stage/idrift_newmodels.sbatch MODELS array (gpu_sun, o2_runner_v2.py) -- hardware_confirmed and inference_config_confirmed are true only for these two. The other seven are inferred from the same 'v3full' output-naming pipeline convention (each has a 243,000-row attempts_v3full_<tag>_labeled.parquet under output/intermediate/labeled_new/, matching exactly what idrift_newmodels.sbatch's pipeline produces) and from manuscript/20_methods.md's own stated claim that all 16 models were served at temperature 0; no sbatch script surviving on disk names these seven tags specifically, so hardware_confirmed and inference_config_confirmed are false for them, flagged in the table with a dagger rather than presented as equally confirmed as the two directly-named models.

Cross-model rankings anywhere in this manuscript are descriptive, not a controlled comparison of model quality: the 16 checkpoints differ in parameter count, quantization, and (for seven of the nine new models) unconfirmed exact serving configuration, so no ranking by drift rate, calibration, or any other outcome should be read as isolating the effect of model identity from these confounded serving differences.
